m.e: I only sleep with guys on the first date when I don't want to see them again.

m.e: Well, you're awfully interested in who I'm screwing and when, but you won't talk about it?

m.e: I'm sure there's a god-- there's no doubt about that.

m.e: She is, no doubt, still somewhere mid-ocean.

m.e: Leaving little doubt their killer is the same man.

m.e: I would be without a wife, no doubt, as that would be the cause of war.

m.t: Není pochyb, že je nejlepší v tomto oboru.
m.e: No doubt it's the best yet on the subject.

m.e: There has been fault on both sides, no doubt of it.

m.e: A man whose word is beyond doubt.
